I The towns and the roads between them

1 town and a boss lair, 0 roads between them. Each card is the town's own panels, in the order they are played. A road is a thing between two towns: a town names where it leads on to, and the toll on a road is the level the town at its far end asks of you.

II Who is out on those roads

5 opponents can be run into in Dark Forest, and one boss waits in the lair. Each one is shown as the panels it brings to a fight, left to right in the order a fight plays them.

Meeting the encounter opening, and whatever it says before anyone swings
Attacks the windup and each attack it can make
Hurt what it does when it is hit, and any status or phase it goes through

IV Legend · everything they can leave behind

Every item on this biome's drop tables, what it is worth, what it does while it is in the bag, and who parts with it.

Hare's Foot

40 gold · 0.2 kg
  • +5 Agility while carried

A hare's hind foot on a thong of gut. The hut's owner did not say what became of the rest of it.

dropped by
The Hollow Warden 50% Bramble Wight 17%

Pitch Torch

15 gold · 1 kg
  • +2 Agility while carried

A stub of pitch-soaked wood. Enough light for one dark hour, and not an hour more. By it you see where to put your feet, and what is stepping towards you.

dropped by
Bramble Wight 50% Sapbound Husk 43%

Boots

45 gold · 1.5 kg
  • +2 Agility while carried

A worn pair of leather boots. They have carried someone a long way already, and they grip where other soles slide.

dropped by
Mossback 43% Barkmask 7%

95 gold · 6 kg
  • Armour · takes 5% off a hit, never more than 5

Oak boards bound in iron. Most of the paint has been beaten off it.

dropped by
Bramble Wight 33% Mossback 29% Barkmask 13%

90 gold · 0.5 kg
